phrases.text: Can you name every place on the Fortnite map after the v43.10 update? Here are all 16 of them, with no labels.
The official map has 11 named locations and 5 landmarks.
I'll pin a spot, give you a moment, then reveal it. Keep score, and tell me how you did at the end!
If you took my last map quiz, heads up: the map changed since then.
Two places are new: Buggy's Beachhead and Nami's Tangerine Grove.
And three are gone: Boogie Boat, Fortune's Fort and Loot Lagoon. So you can't just remember the old answers.
